fields.summary_ko.0: TSMC (TSM) holds a dominant 73% share in the global pure-play foundry market, with 42% share in the Foundry 2.0 market (increasing from 38% at end of 2025), projecting 11% CAGR growth through 2030.
fields.summary_ko.1: TSMC projected mid-50% annual growth in AI accelerator revenue for 2024–2029, though management suggested this could be exceeded, with Q3 HPC revenue representing 68% of total (versus 57% year-over-year).
